item.text: Palaeo-Agent computed richness for all six samples and all 15 Bray–Curtis dissimilarities from raw counts, with no exclusions. I’ll check the values against the formulas and validate the answer file.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python -c 'import json,csv,itertools,pathlib,math
import jsonschema
run=next(pathlib.Path(\"community_run\").glob(\"*/results.json\"))
r=json.loads(run.read_text())
rows=list(csv.reader(open(\"counts.tsv\"),delimiter=\"\\t\"))
ids=[row[0] for row in rows[1:]]
counts={row[0]:list(map(int,row[1:])) for row in rows[1:]}
assert r[\"sample_ids\"]==ids
richness={x[\"sample_id\"]:x[\"richness\"] for x in r[\"diversity\"]}
assert richness=={s:sum(v>0 for v in counts[s]) for s in ids}
distances={}
for i,j in itertools.combinations(range(len(ids)),2):
 a,b=ids[i],ids[j]
 expected=sum(abs(x-y) for x,y in zip(counts[a],counts[b]))/(sum(counts[a])+sum(counts[b]))
 actual=r[\"distances\"][i][j]
 assert math.isclose(actual,expected,rel_tol=1e-15,abs_tol=1e-15)
 distances[a+\"|\"+b]=actual
answer=dict(status=\"completed\",results=dict(richness=richness,braycurtis=distances),assumptions=[],exclusions=[],issues=[],summary=\"Computed taxon richness (counts greater than zero) and all 15 pairwise Bray–Curtis dissimilarities on untransformed specimen counts using Palaeo-Agent community; independently checked against the defining formulas. All six samples and eight taxa were retained.\")
jsonschema.validate(answer,json.load(open(\"answer.schema.json\")))
pathlib.Path(\"answer.json\").write_text(json.dumps(answer,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+\"\\n\")
print(pathlib.Path(\"answer.json\").read_text())'"
